home.faqSubtitle: Answers to the most common questions
home.faqQ1: How do I receive my personalized workout and diet?
home.faqA1: After registration and initial assessment, Nath Ramos creates your complete plan within the platform, tailored to your goals, restrictions and availability.
home.faqQ2: How long does it take to see the first results?
home.faqA2: The first signs appear in 2 to 4 weeks with consistent adherence. More expressive transformations are visible after 8 to 12 weeks.
home.faqQ3: Can I train at home or only at the gym?
home.faqA3: Both! Workouts are adaptable. You inform your environment (gym, home, outdoors) and available equipment.
home.faqA4: In the Transformation and Elite plans, you have access to direct chat and feedback on your responses and daily records.
home.faqQ5: Can the plan be canceled at any time?
home.faqA5: Yes. Cancellation is simple and can be done directly in your student area, with no fines or bureaucracy.
home.faqA6: We accept recurring credit card, Pix and bank slip. Access is released immediately after confirmation.
home.ctaSubtitle: Track your results with Nath Ramos, with personalized plans and continuous support.

about.heroSubtitle: Physical educator passionate about transforming lives through movement and intelligent nutrition.
about.storyParagraph1: For over 10 years in the fitness market, Nath Ramos has built a solid career helping hundreds of students achieve the body and quality of life they always dreamed of. Graduated in Physical Education with post-graduation in Sports Nutrition and High Performance Mentoring.
about.storyParagraph2: Her methodology is based on three pillars: intelligent training, strategic nutrition and human coaching. Nath believes that sustainable results come from real habits, not extreme diets or impossible routines to maintain.
about.storyParagraph3: Today, through her online platform, Nath offers personalized coaching for students across Brazil and abroad, bringing the same level of excellence from her in-person service.
about.missionDesc: Empower people to achieve their best physical and mental version through sustainable methods and human coaching.
about.visionDesc: To be a national reference in personalized fitness coaching, recognized for excellence and lasting results of students.
about.valuesTitle2Desc: Excellence, transparency, empathy, commitment to results and respect for each student's individuality.
about.teamCredentials: Active CREF, Post-graduate in Sports Nutrition, Specialist in Hypertrophy and Weight Loss, Certified Mentor
about.ctaSubtitle: Schedule a free consultation and discover how Nath can help you.

howItWorksPage.heroSubtitle: A simple, structured and 100% focused process on your results.
howItWorksPage.step1Desc: You create your account and answer a detailed assessment: goals, training history, current diet, restrictions, available time and preferences.
howItWorksPage.step2Desc: Nath analyzes all your data and puts together a complete and individualized plan, perfectly aligned with what you need to achieve your goals.
howItWorksPage.step3Desc: You execute the plan and record everything on the platform. Nath follows your records, gives feedback and makes adjustments whenever necessary.
howItWorksPage.step4Desc: Every cycle, you evaluate your progress through metrics, photos and performance. Nath adjusts the plan to continue evolving without plateaus.
howItWorksPage.step4Detail3: New goals for the next cycle
howItWorksPage.ctaTitle: Ready to take the first step?
howItWorksPage.ctaSubtitle: Your personalized plan can be ready in 48 hours.

workoutsPage.heroSubtitle: Training programs designed specifically for you, your level and your goals.
workoutsPage.typesSubtitle: Strategically chosen according to your goals
workoutsPage.hypertrophyDesc: Training focused on muscle gain with progressive volume and intensity, proper periodization and exercises selected for each muscle group.
workoutsPage.fatLossDesc: Combination of resistance and metabolic training to maximize caloric expenditure, preserve lean mass and accelerate metabolism throughout the day.
workoutsPage.strengthDesc: Programs focused on maximum strength development in basic exercises (squat, bench press, deadlift), with linear and undulating periodization.
workoutsPage.functionalDesc: Training that works mobility, stability, coordination and general endurance, ideal to improve quality of life, posture and performance in daily activities.
workoutsPage.benefit2: Lower risk of injuries with proper technique
workoutsPage.benefit3: Plan adapted to your available time
workoutsPage.day1Content: Chest and Triceps: 6 exercises, 4 sets each
workoutsPage.day2Content: Back and Biceps: 7 exercises, 3-4 sets each
workoutsPage.day6Content: Running or light aerobic activity: 40-60 min
workoutsPage.ctaSubtitle: Start now and get your plan within 48 hours.

dietsPage.heroSubtitle: Balanced, delicious and 100% adapted meal plans to your routine and goals.
dietsPage.typesSubtitle: Nutritional strategies according to your goal
dietsPage.cuttingDesc: Strategic caloric deficit with high protein content to lose fat while preserving as much muscle mass as possible. Includes satiating meals and weekly adjustments.
dietsPage.bulkingDesc: Controlled caloric surplus with smart macro distribution to gain muscle mass with minimum fat accumulation. Period of 8 to 16 weeks.
dietsPage.maintenanceDesc: Balanced maintenance calorie diet to stabilize body weight, improve body composition and sustain healthy habits in the long term.
dietsPage.tdeeSubtitle: Understand how your caloric needs work
dietsPage.tdeeExplanation: TDEE (Total Daily Energy Expenditure) is the total calories your body burns in a full day, including physical activities, digestion and vital functions. From it, we define whether you will be in deficit, surplus or maintenance.
dietsPage.tdeeComponents: Calculation components: sex, age, weight, height, physical activity rate and thermogenesis of food.
dietsPage.proteinDesc: Essential for muscle building and repair. Approximately 1.6-2.2g per kg of body weight, depending on the goal.
dietsPage.carbsDesc: Main source of energy for training. Strategically distributed throughout the day, focusing on low/medium glycemic index sources.
dietsPage.fatsDesc: Fundamental for hormonal production and general health. About 0.8-1g per kg of body weight, prioritizing unsaturated sources.
dietsPage.ctaTitle: Ready to get your personalized diet?
dietsPage.ctaSubtitle: Meal plans that fit your routine and your taste.

performancePage.heroSubtitle: Track every metric of your progress with charts, reports and clear goals.
performancePage.metricsSubtitle: All the data that matters for your transformation
performancePage.waterDesc: Personalized daily goals, smart reminders and complete history of your water intake.
performancePage.sleepDesc: Record of hours slept, sleep quality and impact on muscle recovery and performance.
performancePage.weightDesc: Weight curve, BMI, anthropometric measurements and comparison photos to visualize your real evolution.
performancePage.averagesDesc: Calculation of adherence to training, diet, hydration and sleep, with an overall average of your commitment.
performancePage.chartDesc: Visualize your trajectory and identify trends over time.
performancePage.ctaTitle: Want to truly track your progress?
performancePage.ctaSubtitle: Concrete data so you never again lose control of your results.

mentoringPage.heroSubtitle: Exclusive, close and intense coaching for those who want faster and deeper results.
mentoringPage.step1Desc: Initial call up to 90 minutes to deeply understand your history, real challenges and ambitious goals.
mentoringPage.step2Desc: Complete plan of training, nutrition, supplementation and habits, built together with you.
mentoringPage.step3Desc: Every two weeks, individual calls to review results, adjust the plan and maintain motivation.
mentoringPage.step4Desc: At the end of the mentoring, you receive a plan to maintain your results and continue evolving.
mentoringPage.meetingsDesc: Biweekly video calls with Nath for deepening, adjustments and short, medium and long-term strategies.
mentoringPage.chatDesc: Exclusive channel to ask questions, share difficulties and celebrate achievements every day.
mentoringPage.chat3: Support during travel, events and eating out
mentoringPage.premium4: Access to all exclusive e-books and materials
mentoringPage.ctaSubtitle: Only 10 students per cycle to ensure coaching excellence.
